# Effects of exercise on sleep: a review

## Abstract

We reviewed trials of exercise and sleep. 30 trials were included. The data was pooled and the effect was significant.

## Introduction

Exercise is very important (Doe et al., 2019).

## Methods

We looked at papers we knew about and picked the good ones.

## Results

Thirty trials were found. Exercise improved sleep.

## Discussion

Exercise clearly works. This proves it.

## References

1. Doe A. A review. Sleep. 2019;1:1-2.
